lines.t: Verse 1
Morning spills through my window
Soft as mercy on the ground
Every step feels like a promise
Every breath is heaven-sound
Bare feet on the quiet road
Peace is all I need to know
In the simple light of day
I feel the Father’s love at play
Pre-Chorus
Heaven leans into the earth
In the ordinary, I see worth
And in the stillness of Your voice
My heart remembers how to rejoice
Chorus
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach
Heaven and earth are meeting here
In the little things, Your glory shines
Love is close, and the way is clear
No heavy burden, no fear of night
Just Your presence, warm and bright
I am Yours, and You are near
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach here
Verse 2
Birds sing out in golden light
Trees bow low in gentle sight
Even the wind feels like a hymn
When I am walking close to Him
Every sunset, every dawn
Whispers that I still belong
To a kingdom not of man
But a Kingdom made by His hand
Pre-Chorus
Heaven leans into the earth
In the ordinary, I see worth
And in the stillness of Your voice
My heart remembers how to rejoice
Chorus
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach
Heaven and earth are meeting here
In the little things, Your glory shines
Love is close, and the way is clear
No heavy burden, no fear of night
Just Your presence, warm and bright
I am Yours, and You are near
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach here
Bridge
A table spread, a gentle light
A Father’s joy in human life
The fields are green, the waters sing
And all creation knows its King
In Your nearness, I am free
Heaven blooms in what I see
No distance left, no veil between
Just the beauty of the unseen
Final Chorus
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach
Heaven and earth are meeting here
In the little things, Your glory shines
Love is close, and the way is clear
No heavy burden, no fear of night
Just Your presence, warm and bright
I am Yours, and You are near
Walking hand in hand with Mashiach here
